summary: Adds an 'NSF / Insufficient Funds Fee' billable category (nsf_charge, per_unit $35.00, default on the Activity invoice, no activity source) to Still Creek Ranch's active contract rate card for Bedrock-to-community billing. One contract_reimbursables row; nothing else changes.

preflight.name: Still Creek Ranch has exactly one active contract
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM contracts WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND status = 'active'

preflight.name: that contract has no nsf_charge category yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM contract_reimbursables r JOIN contracts c ON c.id = r.contract_id WHERE c.community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND r.category = 'nsf_charge'

expected_changes: Inserts one contract_reimbursables row on Still Creek Ranch's active contract: category nsf_charge, description 'NSF / Insufficient Funds Fee', billing_method per_unit, unit_price 35.00, sort_order 60, default_on_invoice true, vantaca_source NULL.
No other contract, invoice or accounting row changes.

verify.name: Still Creek's active contract has exactly one NSF fee: per unit $35.00, on the invoice by default, no activity source
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM contract_reimbursables r JOIN contracts c ON c.id = r.contract_id WHERE c.community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND c.status = 'active' AND r.category = 'nsf_charge' AND r.description = 'NSF / Insufficient Funds Fee' AND r.billing_method = 'per_unit' AND r.unit_price = 35.00 AND r.default_on_invoice AND r.vantaca_source IS NULL

verify.name: no other community's NSF configuration changed (the three existing nsf_charge rows stay off by default)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM contract_reimbursables r JOIN contracts c ON c.id = r.contract_id WHERE r.category = 'nsf_charge' AND c.community_id <> 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND r.default_on_invoice
